content.text: The Boston Red Sox (1-0), coming off their first Opening Day shutout in 11 years, look for more of the same on Saturday night when they take on the Cincinnati Reds again on Saturday night at Great American Ball Park in Cincinnati.CINCINNATI, OHIO - MARCH 26: Jarren Duran #16 of the Boston Red Sox steals second base during the first inning of the Opening Day game against the Ci...How to Watch Red Sox vs RedsDate: Saturday, March 28, 2026Time: 4:00 PM ETChannel: NESN, MLB.TV - Boston Red SoxStream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Garrett Crochet combined with three relievers on a four-hitter on Thursday as Boston beat the Reds 3-0. Crochet allowed three of those hits while striking out eight and Ceddanne Rafaela broke up a scoreless game with an RBI single in the seventh inning. Trevor Story and Jarren Duran padded the lead with run-scoring base hits in the top of the ninth and Aroldis Chapman locked down the win with a 1-2-3 bottom of the frame.Andrew Abbott scattered seven hits over six scoreless innings before the bullpen was touched up after the left-hander departed the game. Sal Stewart provided most of the Cincinnati offense, getting three of the team’s four hits, including a pair of doubles. Pierce Johnson was tagged with the loss after giving up hits to two of the three batters he faced to open the top of the seventh.Right-hander Brady Singer gets the start for the Reds on Saturday after working to a 4.03 ERA and 1.238 WHIP across 32 starts and 169.2 innings last season. Newcomer Sonny Gray, a veteran right-hander acquired in a trade with the St. Louis Cardinals, makes his Red Sox debut on Saturday.
